businessScenario: 可视化分析平台-机构配置参数管理，维护县域支行标志和重点县域支行标志

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 县域机构信息与配置参数合并
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE VT_C_ORG_ORG_ORGPARAM_CONFIG_01 AS
SELECT 
   T1.org_id AS org_no
  ,NVL(T2.pboc_large_pay_bank_no,'') AS pboc_large_pay_bank_no
  ,NVL(T2.org_type_cd,'') AS org_type_cd
  ,NVL(T2.org_attac_inf,'') AS org_attac_inf
  ,T1.is_xy AS cty_scope_sbubrch_flag
  ,T1.is_zd AS empha_cty_scope_sbubrch_flag
FROM O_VSAP_A_ORG_CTY_ADDIT_RECOR_DTL T1
LEFT JOIN C_ORG_ORG_ORGPARAM_CONFIG T2
  ON T1.org_id = T2.org_no
WHERE T1.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
  AND T1.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'

knowledgeBlocks.businessScenario: 可视化分析平台-从ODM层获取当前有效的县域支行信息，与已有配置参数做左关联合并，保留手工维护的非县域字段，更新县域标志和重点县域标志
knowledgeBlocks.tableJoinLogic: 以ODM层县域附加信息表(O_VSAP_A_ORG_CTY_ADDIT_RECOR_DTL)为主表，通过机构号(org_id = org_no)左关联CDM层机构配置参数表(C_ORG_ORG_ORGPARAM_CONFIG)，保留手工维护的pboc_large_pay_bank_no、org_type_cd、org_attac_inf字段，同时从ODM表获取县域标志(is_xy)和重点县域标志(is_zd)
knowledgeBlocks.queryDimensions: 机构号、县域标志、重点县域标志、人行大额支付行号、机构类型、机构附属信息
